title: Car-sharing providers to explore
intro: Soft CTAs for established Dutch car-sharing options when occasional four wheels fit your life. Confirm live rates, zones and insurance terms in each app — this block is not a ranking of fleets.

items.reason: Station- and neighbourhood-based shared cars — a classic complement to OV when you need occasional four wheels near hubs.
Bike subscription for everyday city trips between car-share bookings — keep ownership optional longer.
Train travel as the default long-distance mode — combine with car sharing for the last mile or weekend errands.
